name: Split-step ready bounce
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and knees softly bent.
Stay on the balls of your feet and bounce lightly without locking your knees.
Every few seconds, add a small split-step landing before resetting.
safety_note: Keep the bounce small and quiet. Stop if your knees or ankles feel painful.

name: Wall-clock lunges
dosage: 3 sets of 6 lunges per direction, 45 seconds rest
instructions: Imagine a clock on the floor around you and step toward 12, 3, 6, and 9 o'clock.
Reach the lead foot out and bend the lead knee over the middle of the foot.
Push through the lead foot to return to the center before the next direction.
safety_note: Use a shorter reach if you cannot keep the heel and knee aligned comfortably. Hold a wall for balance if needed.

name: Multi-directional lunge hold
focus: Balance over the base of support
dosage: 3 sets of 4 holds per leg, 20 seconds per hold
instructions: Step into a comfortable forward or lateral lunge.
Pause with the hips stacked over or slightly behind the front ankle.
Hold the position while keeping the chest tall, then push back to center.
safety_note: Do not force extra depth. Reduce the range if you feel pinching or loss of balance.

name: Knee-to-wall ankle drill
instructions: Stand facing a wall with the working foot a short step back.
Drive the knee forward toward the wall while keeping the heel down.
Return to the start and repeat without letting the foot turn out.
safety_note: Keep the movement pain-free and avoid forcing the knee past a comfortable range.

name: Bodyweight hip hinge
instructions: Stand tall with knees softly bent and hands across your chest.
Push your hips back while keeping a long spine.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, then squeeze the glutes to stand.
safety_note: Keep the movement controlled. If your back rounds, reduce the range.

name: Overhead wall slide
instructions: Stand with your back near a wall and forearms touching the wall.
Slide the arms upward while keeping the ribs down and elbows connected to the wall.
Reach as high as you can without arching your lower back, then return slowly.
safety_note: Use a smaller range if the shoulders feel pinched. Do not force the arms overhead.

name: High-elbow shadow swing
focus: High elbow and full extension at the top
instructions: Start with the racket hand near the shoulder and the elbow high.
Reach upward and forward as if meeting the shuttle at a high contact point.
Finish tall with the arm extended, then reset slowly.
safety_note: Swing at a controlled speed. Use a light racket or no racket if the shoulder feels uncomfortable.

name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Hold a light band at chest height with straight arms.
Pull the band apart by moving the shoulder blades back and down.
Return slowly while keeping the ribs stacked over the hips.
safety_note: Use a light band and stop if the shoulders or elbows hurt.

name: Scapular wall push-up
instructions: Place both hands on a wall at shoulder height.
Without bending the elbows much, let the shoulder blades glide together, then push the wall away.
Keep the neck long and the ribs down.
safety_note: Keep the range small and pain-free.

name: Single-leg balance reach
instructions: Balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Reach the free foot forward, out to the side, and back without touching down.
Return to the center between reaches and switch legs after the set.
safety_note: Stand near a wall or chair for support. Keep the standing knee aligned with the foot.

name: Lateral shuffle to ready stance
focus: Wide base and repeatable ready position
instructions: Shuffle two or three steps in one direction, staying low.
Land in a ready stance with feet wider than your shoulders.
Reset your balance before shuffling back.
safety_note: Keep the steps short and stay on the balls of your feet. Stop if you lose control.
